_readme: This is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for all projects. Do not inject JD logic here. Each project has fixed bullets, fixed tags, fixed priority. The resume prompt reads this file and selects based on jd_profile.json tags.

projects.name: PayStride
projects.subtitle: Multi-Tenant SaaS Payroll Management System
projects.tech_display: Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, Hibernate, REST API, JWT
bullets: Architected multi-tenant RBAC system using Spring Security and JWT, enforcing complete data isolation across all API endpoints.
Optimized MySQL query execution through strategic indexing and schema normalization, reducing average response latency by 40%.
Engineered BigDecimal payroll computation engine handling statutory deductions (PF 12%, ESI 0.75%) and 1.5x overtime multipliers with zero precision loss.

projects.name: EduTrack
projects.subtitle: Student Management Portal
projects.tech_display: Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, REST API
bullets: Developed RESTful CRUD APIs over Spring Boot handling 500+ student records with optimized MongoDB aggregation queries.
Designed modular service architecture enabling independent scaling of student, batch, and reporting modules.
Implemented dual-layer validation (client-side and server-side) reducing data entry errors by 25%.

projects.name: Customised Virtual File System (CVFS)
projects.subtitle: In-Memory Linux-like File Manager
projects.tech_display: C, C++, Data Structures, OS Concepts
bullets: Simulated Linux file system operations (open, read, write, lseek) in C++ using inode-based metadata management and a custom shell interpreter.
Achieved O(1) file lookup by designing hash table-based inode indexing with chaining for collision resolution.
Implemented in-memory file allocation table using C++ classes managing file permissions, ownership, and hierarchical directory traversal.

projects.name: Concurrent FTP Server
projects.subtitle: Multi-Client File Transfer Protocol Server
projects.tech_display: C, POSIX Threads, TCP Sockets, Multithreading
bullets: Engineered concurrent client handling using POSIX threads over TCP sockets, supporting simultaneous file transfers without data corruption.
Implemented thread-safe resource management using mutex and semaphore primitives, eliminating race conditions under concurrent load.
Designed application-layer protocol over raw sockets handling authentication, file listing, upload, and download command sequences.

projects.name: Customized DBMS
projects.subtitle: Relational Database Engine in C++
bullets: Designed SQL query parser in C++ supporting full DDL (CREATE, DROP) and DML (INSERT, SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE) operations.
Engineered B-tree indexing for accelerated record lookup, reducing sequential scan overhead on large in-memory datasets.
Simulated multi-table relational schema with join operations, constraint enforcement, and STL-based record storage.

projects.name: ProcMemInspector
projects.subtitle: Linux Process Memory Layout Analyzer
bullets: Developed a /proc filesystem parser in C to extract and display virtual memory layout of live Linux processes including stack, heap, data, BSS, and mapped library segments.
Implemented process statistics monitoring by reading /proc/[pid]/maps and /proc/[pid]/status with structured output formatting.
Analyzed virtual address space segmentation demonstrating memory isolation boundaries and shared library loading behavior.

projects.name: Command Suite
projects.subtitle: Re-implementation of Linux Core Utilities
projects.tech_display: C, Linux System Programming, POSIX System Calls
bullets: Re-implemented core Linux utilities (ls, ps, mv, touch, uname) using POSIX system calls including stat(), opendir(), and getpid().
Handled file permission bitmask parsing, directory traversal, and live process status extraction from /proc filesystem.
Implemented full flag-based argument parsing matching standard GNU utility behavior and POSIX error code conventions.

projects.name: System Logger
projects.subtitle: Advanced Linux System Activity Logger
projects.tech_display: C, Linux System Programming, File Locking
bullets: Designed timestamp-driven log rotation mechanism integrated with Linux syslog facilities for centralized event tracking.
Implemented configurable log level filtering (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR) with output to file descriptors and stderr.
Enforced concurrent write safety using fcntl() file locking, preventing log corruption under multi-process scenarios.

projects.name: Restaurant Record App
projects.subtitle: Full-Stack Dining Management System
bullets: Developed CRUD REST APIs using Express.js and MongoDB with JWT token-based authentication for secure data access.
Implemented Angular lazy-loading and service abstraction to optimize frontend module loading and component reuse.
Designed modular routing architecture supporting role-based menu and record visibility.

projects.name: Event Hub
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Event Coordination Portal
bullets: Integrated Socket.io WebSocket layer for real-time event status broadcast to connected clients with sub-second latency.
Designed modular Angular component architecture for scalable event categorization and search functionality.
Implemented event registration workflows with Express.js APIs and MongoDB document persistence.
